diagram: flow

// User Registration Flow
start UserStart

action SubmitForm {
  label: "Submit Registration"
  next: ValidateEmail
}

decision ValidateEmail {
  label: "Email Valid?"
  yes: CreateAccount
  no: ShowError
}

action CreateAccount {
  label: "Create Account"
  next: SendWelcome
}

action SendWelcome {
  label: "Send Welcome Email"
  next: UserEnd
}

end UserEnd
▶
User Start

📝
Submit Form

❓
Email Valid?

✓

✗
Show Error

📧
Send Welcome
Send welcome email
■
User End
Registration complete
